utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. I’m still putting the repair drive together for Saturday on the front porch, so any help would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the start time and a rough helper count so I can keep Saturday’s front-porch logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Vik, thank you so much - I’ve got you down for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course, I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Rosa. What time should I be there on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please. Can you come by for a few hours on Saturday and help on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — I’m still set for Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll be there to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps a lot, Vik. I appreciate you being there Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still set to help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. Just let me know what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Sam. I’ll send you the time, and we’ll meet on the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Pia - I’m still putting together the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you’re free, I’d be grateful for the hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m keeping the schedule tight—what time do you want me there on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — I’d really appreciate that! I’ll put you down for Saturday on the front porch.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
